title: project-launcher-lock
description: Lock of the project-local launcher (.swissknifeman/launcher.lock.json), written by `swissknifeman project init|sync`. It is committed with the project and holds no machine-specific path, user name or hub location.

protocol.description: Launcher protocol of the managed files: the environment contract between the launcher and the hub.

template_sha256.description: SHA-256 (lowercase hex) of the launcher template the managed launcher was written from.

managed_files.description: Project-relative POSIX paths that `project sync` owns and may replace.
